prompt: Show me everything on the Editorial calendar between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-07.
expected: Resolves state_root, loads the Editorial database_id and data_source_id, queries POST /v1/data_sources/{id}/query with on_or_after and on_or_before, and returns title, date, status, and URL without writing.
actual: Resolved <state_root>/calendars.md. Found Editorial data_source_id. Posted a bounded date filter to /v1/data_sources/{id}/query with Notion-Version 2025-09-03. Returned three pages with title, date, status, and URL. No write.

prompt: Add a page titled Launch review on the Work calendar for 2026-04-15 at 09:00 in Asia/Taipei.
expected: Confirms the live date property, creates the page with parent data_source_id, reads the page back, and reports title, date, status, and URL.
actual: Retrieved the data source schema, confirmed the date property name, POSTed /v1/pages with parent data_source_id and start 2026-04-15T09:00:00+08:00, then read the page back and returned title, date, status, and URL.

prompt: Move Marketing Launch from next Tuesday to next Thursday. Two pages share that title.
expected: Queries the Tuesday window, finds two title matches, and asks for a page URL or ID before any update.
actual: Queried the Tuesday window and found two Marketing Launch pages. Stopped and asked for the page URL. No PATCH was sent.
